guide: Open Start and type your company name and your own targets in the yellow cells: the margin you want, your lowest margin, the rating you want, the reply days, the repeat customer share and the growth you plan.

Products lists the 24 products with price, cost and status. The list margin, the age, the revenue, profit and margin of the last 12 months, the units, the rating and the checks fill in from the sales and review sheets.
Product month sales holds the units, revenue and costs of each product by month and channel. The total cost, the margin and the margin share fill in, and the dashboard and charts read this sheet.

Reviews and Review topics follow what customers say. Each review gets the days to reply and a check against your reply window; the rating and the topic charts show where the scent, the burn or the packaging lets you down.

Product ideas, New product trials, Sample feedback and Waitlist run new products from the first idea to the launch: expected margin, trial sell-through (units sold as a share of units made), tester scores and customers waiting.
Campaigns and Campaign results show the spend, the orders, the revenue and the return on spend of each campaign; Newsletter sends and Photo shoots show what each send and each shoot cost and brought.
Customers and Repeat customers by cohort show who orders again, who has not ordered for months and how the share of repeat customers changes by first order month.

Seasonal plan turns last year's units and the demand factor of each month into the units to make next year; Gift set ideas shows the margin of each set, and Competitor watch compares prices for 100 g.
Retire list records your decision on slow products and checks the live units and margin; Channels and Team hold the fees, the payout days and the phones that the messages use.

Use the 14 calculators before you decide: margin, mix, rating, reply time, repeat rate, customer lifetime value, campaign return, go or stop, seasonal stock, gift set, sell-through, retire or keep, newsletter payback and a what-if grid.
Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and tap a message link to open a chat with the text already written (28 messages). Check your own local rules for labels and sales tax.

listing.title: Handmade Candle and Soap Range and Growth Excel Template: Product Margin, Review Replies, Repeat Customers, Campaigns, Seasonal Plan
listing.headline: Margin, reviews, repeat customers and growth for a handmade studio
listing.description:
Keep the range of a handmade candle, soap and body-care studio healthy and grow it with one Excel workbook. Products shows every product with the revenue, profit and margin of the last 12 months after fees, shipping and labour, the units of the last 3 months, the rating of the last 90 days and a check against your target margin and target rating, so you see which product to push, reprice or retire.

Reviews and Review topics keep every review with its rating, topic and the days you took to reply, flag the reviews still waiting and show the average rating by month, category and topic. Product ideas, New product trials, Sample feedback and Waitlist run a new product from the first idea to the launch with the expected margin, the sell-through of the trial batch, the tester scores and the customers waiting for it.

Campaigns, Campaign results, Newsletter sends and Photo shoots show the spend, the orders, the revenue and the return on spend of each activity. Customers and Repeat customers by cohort show who orders again and who has gone quiet. Seasonal plan turns last year's units and the demand of each month into the units to make next year, Gift set ideas shows the margin of every set, Competitor watch compares prices for 100 g and Retire list records what you decided about slow products.

14 calculators cover margin, range mix, average rating, reply time, repeat rate, customer lifetime value, campaign return, go or stop, seasonal stock, gift set cost, sell-through, retire or keep, newsletter payback and a what-if grid. Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and send 28 ready messages with the details already written in.

This is part seven of the Handmade Product Maker suite. A standard Excel workbook with no macros and no subscription, 15 languages in one purchase, with a demo copy full of sample data to explore first. Check your own local rules for labels and sales tax; the workbook keeps your records and makes no legal claims.

messages.text: Hello {customer}, we are sorry that {product} did not meet your hopes. Please tell us what went wrong and we will put it right.

messages.moment: Customer: your waitlist product is back
messages.text: Hello {customer}, good news: {product} is back in stock. You asked us to tell you first, so we are holding it for you for a few days.

messages.moment: Customer: a new scent for the season
messages.text: Hello {name}, a new seasonal scent is ready in our studio. As a customer from {country} you can see it first on the shop page. Thank you for supporting a small studio.

messages.moment: Customer: could you test our new product
messages.text: Hello {tester}, thank you for the feedback on {idea}. Could you test one more sample and tell us your scent and look scores again?

messages.moment: Customer: a discount for your next order
messages.text: Hello {name}, it has been {months_since} months since your last order. Here is a small discount for your next order. We would love to see you again.

messages.moment: Customer: thank you for ordering again
messages.text: Hello {name}, thank you for ordering again. This is order number {orders} with us, and we are glad you keep coming back.

messages.moment: Maker: the trial batch is approved
messages.text: Hello {maker}, the trial batch of {idea} is approved. {units_sold} of {units_made} units sold and the testers scored {feedback_score}. Please plan the first full batch.

messages.moment: Maker: make the seasonal gift set
messages.text: Hello, please plan the batches for the gift set {set_name} ({components}). It launches on {launch_on}.

messages.moment: Maker: the scent feedback on a product
messages.text: Hello, a tester gave {idea} a scent score of {scent_score} and a look score of {look_score}: {comment}. Please read it before the next test batch.

messages.moment: Maker: stop making it after this batch
messages.text: Hello, we decided on {decision} for {product}. Please tell us the date of the last batch and how many units are still planned.

messages.moment: Packer: gift set boxes are ready
messages.text: Hello, the boxes for the gift set {set_name} are ready for packing. It launches on {launch_on}: {components}.

messages.moment: Packer: campaign order wrapping
messages.text: Hello, the campaign {name} starts on {date}. Expect about {orders} orders and please prepare the wrapping and the cards.

messages.moment: Shop assistant: list the new product
messages.text: Hello, please list the new product {idea} ({category}) at {target_price} on the shop and the marketplace when the first batch is ready.

messages.moment: Shop assistant: reply to the new reviews
messages.text: Hello, {name} has {reviews_waiting} reviews waiting for a reply. Please answer them within the reply days and tell me about any problem.

messages.moment: Shop assistant: send the newsletter
messages.text: Hello, please send the newsletter on {topic} on {date} to {recipients} recipients. Check the links and the code first.

messages.moment: Shop assistant: update the photos
messages.text: Hello, please update the photos of {name} on the shop and the marketplace. Check the product page after the update.

messages.moment: Shop assistant: the campaign code starts
messages.text: Hello, the campaign {name} with the code {code} starts on {date} on {channel}. Please set up the code and check it works.

messages.moment: Shop assistant: move it to the sale page
messages.text: Hello, please move {product} to the sale page. We decided on {decision} and want to sell the remaining stock first.

messages.moment: Owner: a rating fell below the target
messages.text: Hello, the rating of {name} is {rating_90d} in the last 90 days, below the target. {reviews_waiting} reviews wait for a reply.

messages.moment: Owner: low margin and low sales
messages.text: Hello, {name} sold {units_90d} units in the last 3 months and its margin check is: {margin_check}. Please decide whether to reprice or retire it.

messages.moment: Owner: a campaign lost money
messages.text: Hello, the campaign {name} spent {spend} and made {revenue} in revenue from {orders} orders. After the margin it lost money. Please decide whether to repeat it.

messages.moment: Owner: repeat customers are rising
messages.text: Hello, of {customers} customers whose first order was in {month}, {repeat_customers} ordered again. Please read the cohort chart.

messages.moment: Owner: the new product trial result
messages.text: Hello, the trial of {idea} sold {units_sold} of {units_made} units with a tester score of {feedback_score}. Decision: {decision}.

messages.moment: Owner: the seasonal plan is ready
messages.text: Hello, the plan for {month_name} is ready: make {plan_units} units, finish planning by {plan_by}. Please check it with the makers.

messages.moment: Owner: the monthly report is ready
messages.text: Hello, the growth report for {month} is ready: {customers} new customers and {repeat_customers} who ordered again. Please read it on the dashboard.

messages.moment: Accountant: campaign spend this quarter
messages.text: Hello, the campaign {name} on {date} cost {spend} and brought {revenue} in revenue. Please record the spend.

messages.moment: Accountant: photo shoot costs
messages.text: Hello, the photo shoot {theme} on {date} cost {cost} for {products} products. Please record it under marketing.

documents.title: Product range report for a product
paragraphs: Product range report of {set:company}, dated {today}.

{col:products.name} ({col:products.category}, status {col:products.status}) sells at {col:products.retail_price} with a unit cost of {col:products.unit_cost}. It has been in the range for {col:products.age_months} months.

In the last 12 months it earned {col:products.revenue_12m} in revenue and {col:products.profit_12m} in profit, a margin of {col:products.margin_12m}. Units in the last 3 months: {col:products.units_90d}. Margin check: {col:products.margin_check}.
Use the report to decide whether to push, reprice or retire the product.
documents.note: Sample wording, adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Product profit ranking entry
paragraphs: Product profit ranking of {set:company}, dated {today}.

{col:products.name}: revenue in 12 months {col:products.revenue_12m}, profit {col:products.profit_12m}, margin {col:products.margin_12m}. The margin you want is {set:target_margin} and the lowest you accept is {set:min_margin}.
The list margin is {col:products.margin}. The margin in 12 months is lower because it counts fees, shipping and labour. Check: {col:products.margin_check}.
Compare it with the other products on the Products sheet before you change a price.
documents.note: Sample wording, adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Review summary for a product
paragraphs: Review summary of {set:company}, dated {today}.
{col:products.name}: average rating in the last 90 days {col:products.rating_90d}; the rating you want is {set:target_rating}. Rating check: {col:products.rating_check}.
Reviews waiting for a reply: {col:products.reviews_waiting}. Replies should go out within {set:reply_days} days.
Read the topics on the Reviews sheet, answer each review and tell the maker what customers say about the scent, the burn and the packaging.
documents.note: Sample wording, adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: New product proposal
paragraphs: New product proposal of {set:company}, dated {today}.
Idea: {col:ideas.idea} ({col:ideas.category}), from {col:ideas.source}, owner {col:ideas.owner}. Stage: {col:ideas.stage}.
Expected price {col:ideas.target_price}, expected cost {col:ideas.est_unit_cost}, expected margin {col:ideas.expected_margin}. Test batches so far: {col:ideas.test_batches}. {col:ideas.idea_check}.
Decide whether to run a trial batch, ask testers for feedback and set the launch date.
documents.note: Sample wording, adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Campaign report
paragraphs: Campaign report of {set:company}, dated {today}.
{col:campaigns.name} ({col:campaigns.kind}) on {col:campaigns.channel}, started {col:campaigns.date}, code {col:campaigns.code}.

Spend {col:campaigns.spend}, orders {col:campaigns.orders}, revenue {col:campaigns.revenue}. Return on spend {col:campaigns.return_on_spend}; profit after the spend {col:campaigns.profit}. Result: {col:campaigns.result}.
Keep the kinds that pay back, change or stop the ones that do not.
documents.note: Sample wording, adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Seasonal plan for one month
paragraphs: Seasonal plan of {set:company}, dated {today}.
{col:seasonal.month_name} is a {col:seasonal.season} month with a demand factor of {col:seasonal.demand_factor}. Units sold in the last 12 full months: {col:seasonal.units_last_year}.

Units to make: {col:seasonal.plan_units}, which is {col:seasonal.plan_gap} against last year, using last year's units, the demand factor and the growth you set. Finish planning by {col:seasonal.plan_by}. {col:seasonal.plan_check}.
Share the plan with the makers and order materials early enough for the batches.
documents.note: Sample wording, adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Gift set catalogue entry
paragraphs: {col:giftsets.set_name} by {set:company}, for {col:giftsets.occasion}.
Contents: {col:giftsets.components}. Price {col:giftsets.price} before sales tax.
Our cost is {col:giftsets.cost}, the profit on one set is {col:giftsets.profit_each} and the margin is {col:giftsets.margin}. Launch on {col:giftsets.launch_on}. {col:giftsets.margin_check}.
Check your own local rules for what a gift pack label must show.
documents.note: Sample wording, adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Customer growth report for a first order month
paragraphs: Customer growth report of {set:company}, dated {today}.

Customers whose first order was in {col:cohorts.month}: {col:cohorts.customers}. Of them {col:cohorts.repeat_customers} ordered again, a repeat share of {col:cohorts.repeat_share}. The cohort is {col:cohorts.age_months} months old.
Your target repeat share is {set:repeat_target}.
Younger cohorts have had less time to order again, so compare cohorts of the same age.
documents.note: Sample wording, adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Retire list report
paragraphs: Retire list report of {set:company}, dated {today}.
{col:retire.product}: reviewed on {col:retire.date} with {col:retire.units_90d} units and a margin of {col:retire.margin_pct}. Decision: {col:retire.decision}, decided on {col:retire.decided_on}.
Today: {col:retire.live_units} units in the last 3 months and a margin of {col:retire.live_margin} over 12 months. {col:retire.retire_check}.
Tell the makers and the shop assistant when a product stops and sell the remaining stock first.
documents.note: Sample wording, adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Monthly growth report for the owner
paragraphs: Monthly growth report of {set:company}, dated {today}.

Month of {col:pmonths.month}, {col:pmonths.product} on {col:pmonths.channel}: {col:pmonths.units} units, revenue {col:pmonths.revenue}, total cost {col:pmonths.cost}, margin {col:pmonths.margin} ({col:pmonths.margin_pct}).
Read the dashboard and the charts for the whole range: revenue and margin by month, reviews, repeat customers, campaigns and ideas.
Write down the three things to push, fix or stop next month.
documents.note: Sample wording, adapt it to your own practice.

zh.Campaigns and Campaign results show the: 营销活动和 活动结果 显示每个营销活动的支出、订单、收入和支出回报； 时事通讯发送 和 拍摄照片 显示每次发送和每次拍摄的成本和带来的费用。
zh.Customers and Repeat customers by cohort: 客户和 按群组划分的回头客 显示谁再次订购、谁已经几个月没有订购以及回头客的比例按第一个订购月份的变化情况。
zh.Seasonal plan turns last year's units an: 季节性计划 将去年的单位和每个月的需求系数转换为明年的单位； 礼品套装创意显示每组的边距，竞争对手手表比较 100 克的价格。
zh.Retire list records your decision on slo: 退休名单 记录您对慢速产品的决定并检查实时单位和利润；渠道和团队保留费用、付款天数以及消息使用的电话。
zh.Use the 14 calculators before you decide: 在做出决定之前使用 14 个计算器：利润、组合、评级、回复时间、重复率、客户终身价值、活动回报、进行或停止、季节性库存、礼品套装、销售、退休或保留、时事通讯回报和假设网格。
zh.Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow: 打印 10 张纸和 10 个文档，遵循 10 个清单，然后点击消息链接以打开与已写文本的聊天（28 条消息）。检查您当地的标签和销售税规则。
zh.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: 本工作簿的所有下拉选项。修改此处的选项，所有工作表都会同步更新。
zh.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: 数据随工作表自动更新。更改年份即可查看往年数据。
zh.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: 在黄色单元格中选择，其余内容将自动填写。可直接打印。
zh.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: 在此编辑消息内容；大括号中的字段会自动从每行资料填入。相关链接位于各个表格中。
zh.Choose a record: each step gets its due: 选择一条记录：每个步骤都会生成到期日期。每条记录请复制一份此工作表。
zh.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: 工作表实时图表。在黄色单元格中选择后，所有图表和仪表图都会自动更新。

nl.Sell the remaining stock at the sale pri: Verkoop de resterende voorraad tegen de verkoopprijs
nl.Remove the product from the shop and the: Verwijder het product uit de winkel en de prijslijsten
nl.Write the decision date on the retire li: Schrijf de beslissingsdatum op de uittredingslijst
nl.Check the margin of each gift set: Controleer de marge van elke cadeauset
nl.Plan the batches with the makers: Plan de batches samen met de makers
nl.Put the sets on the shop and the line sh: Zet de sets op de winkel en op het lijnblad
nl.Tell customers and shops about the sets: Vertel klanten en winkels over de sets
nl.Count the sets sold and the leftovers: Tel de verkochte sets en de restjes
nl.Read the revenue and margin by month and: Lees de omzet en marge per maand en categorie
nl.Read the rating and the topics: Lees de beoordeling en de onderwerpen
nl.Check the repeat customer share and the: Controleer het aandeel terugkerende klanten en de cohorten
nl.Read the campaign returns and stop the w: Lees de campagneresultaten en stop de zwakken
nl.Review the ideas and the trials: Bekijk de ideeën en de beproevingen
nl.Look at the competitor watch prices: Kijk naar de horlogeprijzen van de concurrent
nl.Write the three goals for the next quart: Schrijf de drie doelen voor het volgende kwartaal op
nl.Products rated at or above the target: Producten die op of boven het doel zijn beoordeeld
nl.Products at or above the target margin: Producten op of boven de doelmarge
nl.New and repeat customers by month: Nieuwe en terugkerende klanten per maand
nl.Open Start and type your company name an: Open Start en typ uw bedrijfsnaam en uw eigen doelstellingen in de gele cellen: de gewenste marge, uw laagste marge, de gewenste beoordeling, de antwoorddagen, het terugkerende klantenaandeel en de groei die u plant.
nl.Products lists the 24 products with pric: Producten toont de 24 producten met prijs, kosten en status. De lijstmarge, de leeftijd, de omzet, winst en marge van de afgelopen 12 maanden, de eenheden, de beoordeling en de cheques worden ingevuld uit de verkoop- en beoordelingsbladen.
nl.Product month sales holds the units, rev: Verkoop van productmaanden bevat de eenheden, opbrengsten en kosten van elk product per maand en kanaal. De totale kosten, de marge en het margeaandeel worden ingevuld, en het dashboard en de grafieken lezen dit blad.
nl.Reviews and Review topics follow what cu: Recensies en Onderwerpen beoordelen volgen wat klanten zeggen. Elke recensie krijgt de dagen om te reageren en een controle aan de hand van uw antwoordvenster; de beoordeling en de onderwerpgrafieken laten zien waar de geur, de verbranding of de verpakking u in de steek laat.
nl.Product ideas, New product trials, Sampl: Productideeën, Nieuwe productproeven, Voorbeeld feedback en Wachtlijst bieden nieuwe producten vanaf het eerste idee tot aan de lancering: verwachte marge, proefdoorverkoop (eenheden verkocht als percentage van de gemaakte eenheden), testerscores en wachtende klanten.
nl.Campaigns and Campaign results show the: Campagnes en Campagneresultaten tonen de uitgaven, de bestellingen, de opbrengst en het rendement op de uitgaven van elke campagne; Nieuwsbrief verzendt en Fotoshoots laten zien wat elke verzending en elke shoot kostte en opbracht.
nl.Customers and Repeat customers by cohort: Klanten en Herhaalde klanten per cohort laten zien wie opnieuw bestelt, wie al maanden niet heeft besteld en hoe het aandeel terugkerende klanten verandert per eerste bestelmaand.
nl.Seasonal plan turns last year's units an: Seizoensplan zet de eenheden van vorig jaar en de vraagfactor van elke maand om in de eenheden die volgend jaar moeten worden verdiend; Ideeën voor cadeausets toont de marge van elke set, en Concurrent Watch vergelijkt de prijzen voor 100 g.
nl.Retire list records your decision on slo: Lijst met pensioen registreert uw beslissing over langzame producten en controleert de live-eenheden en marge; Kanalen en Team beheren de kosten, de uitbetalingsdagen en de telefoons die de berichten gebruiken.
nl.Use the 14 calculators before you decide: Gebruik de 14 rekenmachines voordat u beslist: marge, mix, beoordeling, reactietijd, herhalingspercentage, lifetime value van de klant, campagnerendement, gaan of stoppen, seizoensvoorraad, cadeauset, doorverkoop, stoppen of behouden, terugverdientijd van de nieuwsbrief en een wat-als-raster.
nl.Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow: Druk 10 vellen en 10 documenten af, volg 10 checklists en tik op een berichtlink om een ​​chat te openen met de reeds geschreven tekst (28 berichten). Controleer uw eigen lokale regels voor labels en omzetbelasting.
nl.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: Alle keuzelijsten in dit bestand. Wijzig hier een item en de wijziging wordt op elk werkblad doorgevoerd.
nl.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: Wordt bijgewerkt vanuit je werkbladen. Wijzig het jaar om terug te kijken.
nl.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: Kies in de gele cel; de rest wordt automatisch ingevuld. Klaar om af te drukken.
nl.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Pas de tekst hier aan; woorden tussen {accolades} worden ingevuld vanuit elke rij. De koppelingen staan in de tabellen.
nl.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Kies een registratie: voor elke stap wordt de uiterste datum berekend. Maak voor elke registratie een kopie van dit werkblad.
nl.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: Actuele grafieken op basis van je werkbladen. Kies in de gele cellen en alle grafieken en meters worden automatisch vernieuwd.
